entity.name: InfiniteZero Foundation
entity.description: Building an open, privacy-first AI commons on Ethereum: participants train shared AI models on their own devices, so raw data stays local. Founded in Computer Science at the University of Oxford; supported by Edge City's SHIFT Grants and the Cosmos Institute.

projects.name: Decentralized Intelligence Network (DIN)
projects.description: Open protocol for training AI as a public good. Participants train models locally with federated learning and share model updates, not raw data, while smart contracts on Ethereum coordinate, verify and reward each training round. DevNet 2.0 is live on Optimism Sepolia, with a public testnet and a fair-launch mainnet planned.

channels.description: Contact for grants and institutional funding.
Crypto donations via Giveth (zero fees; donations are regularly matched).

plans.name: Protocol Sustainer
plans.description: Core funding for DIN protocol development, smart contracts, federated learning infrastructure, validator network scaling, and security audits. Priced at the FLOSS/fund annual ceiling.

plans.name: Goodwill contribution
plans.description: Any amount to support open AI infrastructure built for the public good.

history.description: Edge City SHIFT Grant ($40k supported by Vitalik Buterin) and other early-stage support for the DIN protocol.
Cosmos Institute grantee ($5,000) — awarded by Brendan McCord to support early-stage research into decentralized intelligence networks.
Oxford University CS PhD research grant ($2,000) supporting academic research on decentralized AI and federated learning systems.
